items.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. In addition, for this same single actual Z there exists a probability kernel K from the jointly indexed space A=(((E×E)×(E×E))×[0,∞)) to the full phase E×E. For every deterministic y,xRef,z0 and finite t≥0, K((((y,xRef),z0),t))=P.map(sample↦Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)). Equivalently, for every Borel phase event B, K((((y,xRef),z0),t))(B)=P{sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)∈B}. The probability kernel supplies Borel dependence of these event probabilities on all of y,xRef,z0,t simultaneously. At zero time its exact law is K((((y,xRef),z0),0))=δ_z0. For every Borel real-valued test g:E×E→ℝ and every M≥0 satisfying |g(z)|≤M for all z, g is integrable under each displayed K fiber, sample↦g(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)) is integrable under the actual P, and ∫g(z)K((((y,xRef),z0),t))(dz)=∫g(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample))P(dsample). The same Z and K precede every parameter, test and bound. All original six analytic assumptions and eleven literal definitions are retained; actual P probability, joint Z measurability, initialization, kernel existence and integrability are derived outputs, never convenience premises. All-finite jointly indexed kernel packaging is an attributed ASTIS measure-theoretic elaboration of the authors actual transition-law and bounded-measurable-test interface. The source terminal failed-limit0 convention and the total uncovered-initial-phase convention are distinct; only fixed-parameter AE compatibility of their laws is used. IsMarkovKernel means probability fibers here and asserts no process memorylessness, restart or Chapman-Kolmogorov equation. Actual invariance, path-law expansion/reversal, AE-safe all-L2 operators/Jensen contraction/density, hypocoercivity, implemented sampling, errors/unbounded query costs, composition and full main results remain separate OPEN obligations.
assumptions: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure, including dimension zero. V is real-valued and C²; α,β are nonnegative reals.
Exactly six analytic source hypotheses: α>0; α≤β; V∈C²; for all x,v, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖²; η>0; βη≤1. No third or higher derivative bound.

Standing E,V,α,β,η are fixed. y,xRef,z0,t,sample are arguments of one jointly Borel map. P and ε are literal canonical definitions; measurability, positive support, recurrence, cover and nonaccumulation are produced dependencies.

The deterministic covered-arc characterization and uncovered fallback hold for every sample. Actual all-time agreement and initialization hold on one AE sample event for each fixed parameter triple. No uniform AE event over uncountably many parameter triples and no arbitrary correlated random-parameter law are inferred.

A stopped record has no phase and infinite event time; every covering interval has a live finite record. The last infinite-wait live arc remains covered. The initial-phase fallback is an explicitly labelled ASTIS measurable extension only on the uncovered complement; zero-time exceptional bounces need not have source index0 at t0.

The same single Z supplies all outputs of one K, jointly indexed in deterministic y,xRef,z0 and every finite NNReal time; standing dynamics V,α,β,η stay fixed. The law is the actual exponential-clock full-phase pushforward, not ideal random-reference/momentum returned position at pi.
The bounded tests are Borel real g with every nonnegative global bound M; no continuity, differentiability, extra moment, supplied law or integrability premise is added. Rank0 and M=0 are included.

Zero-time law uses each fixed-parameter AE initialization; it does not assert all-sample zero-time identity or a common AE event over all parameters. Joint measurability alone does not justify correlated random-parameter substitution.

Probability-fiber Markov kernel is distinct from a Markov process. Actual restart/memorylessness/Chapman-Kolmogorov and phase invariance/path reversal remain independent open dependencies; kernel construction is only an optional representation for future invariance proofs.

formulae.label: Actual phase law 3
formulae.tex: g\in L^1(K_{y,r,z,t}),\quad g\circ Z_{y,r,z,t}\in L^1(P)\qquad(|g|\le M).
